text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, August 17, 2018 Posted by admin on August 17th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL) and Merck (MRK). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -57 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +396.32 (+1.58%) at 25,558.73.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.40%.
There were 27 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Walmart (WMT) +9.33% and Boeing (BA) +4.29%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Intel (INTC) -0.61% and Disney (DIS) -0.33%.
Walmart (WMT +9.33%) was downgraded to ‘Outperform’ from ‘Strong Buy’ at Raymond James.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down four-tenths of a cent at $2.850 per gallon.
